principles: A node-local JSON file holding learned state is a fork, not a replica: every posterior, calibration, failure memory and memory store must be a shaped impulse served where the data lives, or the nodes learn different things from the same work.
A default endpoint of 127.0.0.1:<port> is a silent write sink on any profile that masks that vessel; writers must route by shape through discovery exactly as readers do.
Converged HEAD is not a converged tree: a sync's success line must check that the worktree matches HEAD (deletions, submodule init, runtime-modified tracked files).
A reconcile check that compares two copies of the same artifact is blind to shared corruption; compare against an independent source.
Profile/data locality must gate unit enablement at the mechanism (pull-sync / apply-inventory), not by hand-masks in a container layer that disappear on recreate.
A watchdog that only ever reports its own action (ok:true) without the stalled metric moving is a metronome; grade it on the effect.
The node that lands must be able to verify, or credit and evidence split across nodes.
Tests that assume a directory is absent will write real artifacts on a box where it exists; fixtures must use a temp root.
A refusal that holds is not a fix while the caller is unattributed: log the caller so the loop can be stopped.
Record hourly 'admits N' / 'unsealed' claims only with the store and node they were read from; node-local numbers flip within hours.
